description: Source code for the front-end of a product review video generator application, built with React and Remotion. Implements UI components for product details, review input, video preview, and download functionality.

methods.name: ProductDetailsForm
methods.description: Component for editing product details with input fields.

methods.name: ReviewForm
methods.description: Component for submitting a review with author and comment fields, and trigger to generate video preview.

methods.name: VideoPreview
methods.description: Component rendering the Remotion Player with video preview, and download button.

methods.description: Reusable input component for text fields.

methods.name: TextArea
methods.description: Reusable textarea component for multi-line text input.
